answer.location_description: A full-image horizontal banding pattern with a period of 4 rows: bright 2-row bands at rows 0-1, 4-5, 8-9, 12-13, 16-17 and 20-21, alternating with dark bands at rows 2-3, 6-7, 10-11, 14-15, 18-19 and 22-23. It spans every column, including the corners and edges far from the nodule.
answer.mechanism: Eight first-layer units are clearly trained; the rest have small, noise-like weights. They form two groups of horizontal gratings in opposite phase. Units 12, 13, 23 and 29 (biases -74, -72, -88, -56) have positive weights on rows 0-1, 4-5, 8-9, ... and negative weights on rows 2-3, 6-7, 10-11, ..., so they switch on only when bright bands sit in that phase. Units 2, 11, 17 and 25 (biases +74, +99, +81, +84) have the opposite phase and are on by default. In layer 2, units u0, u8, u10 and u14 take strong positive input from the first group and strong negative input from the second. Their output weights are positive (+85, +62, +76, +90), so they push toward malignant. Layer-2 units u9 and u11 have the reverse wiring and negative output weights (-99, -66), so they push toward benign. The net effect: horizontal stripes in that phase drive the logit toward malignant, and their absence leaves the default benign pathway in control.
answer.evidence: Unit 12 rows 0-1 are about +6 to +57; rows 2-3 about -10 to -46; rows 4-5 +10 to +62; rows 6-7 -30 to -80; rows 20-21 +11 to +54. Units 13, 23 and 29 show the same row-alternating pattern; unit 23 row 20 is +57, +74, ... and row 6 is -46, -56, -64, -70. Units 2, 11, 17 and 25 show the mirror image, e.g. unit 11 row 2 is +26 to +53 and row 4 is -9 to -49. The pattern is uniform across all 24 columns and continues into the image corners, which is unlike a centred nodule. Layer-2 weights from units (2, 11, 17, 25) vs (12, 13, 23, 29): u0 is -73/-49/-80/-18 vs +64/+65/+21/+60; u8 is -51/-31/-80/-42 vs +99/+73/+29/+38. u9 is +74/+42/+63/+69 vs -46/-35/-10/-9, with output weight -99. The output weights are 85, 62, 76 and 90 on u0, u8, u10 and u14.
answer.main_feature: Beyond the stripes, the same units carry localized deviations near the image centre, for example rows 10-11 at columns 16-19 and rows 14-16 at columns 9-12. These suggest the model also uses nodule brightness and structure in the central region. The genuine nodule signal looks weak, though, compared with the dominant periodic banding detector.
